en.title: pantoprazole sodium for injection: 2.1 and 12.3 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.1 reads “Greater than 15 kg up to 40 kg”. 12.3 reads “body weight of 40 kg and greater”. Example: A child weighing exactly 40 kg gets 20 mg by 2.1 and 40 mg by 12.3. The same text is in 5 labels from 3 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
